root_causes_found: producers.name_normalized column had special characters (periods, ampersands, hyphens) that normalize() strips. batch_matcher uses normalize() on incoming names but looked up pre-normalized DB values. e.g. 'E. Guigal' stored as 'e. guigal', but incoming 'E Guigal' normalized to 'e guigal' — no match. Fixed 4186 producers by stripping non-alphanumeric from name_normalized. Revived 393 wine matches across all sources.

26441 exact duplicate wine rows from Phase B TTB wine creation. Same wine promoted multiple times from different TTB COLA records. Dedup_wines.py script now soft-deletes extras, reassigns linked data to keep_id.
111K wines had no country_id — not just TTB-only records. 10450 inferable from producer.country_id, 3324 from appellation→region→country. Batch-assigned 18432 wines.
